caption: The drawing depicts a single brown bonnet, centered on a plain, off-white or beige background with no other objects or details. The bonnet is composed of intricately woven or textured brown material that covers the crown and extends outward, forming a rounded shape. The inner lining and underside of the brim are shaded with a darker, velvety brown, suggesting a contrast in fabric texture. Attached to the lower sides of the bonnet are two wide, brown ribbons, which are tied together in a bow at the bottom center of the image. The bonnet features a frilled edging around the brim, consistent in its brown coloration, and the overall drawing uses shading and highlights to indicate depth and the material’s texture. There are no additional elements or decorations present, and the drawing appears carefully rendered to emphasize the structure and detail of the headwear.
title: Woman's Bonnet
